task: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

args.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#e0f7fa"/>
  
  <!-- Ground -->
  <path d="M0 250 Q200 280 400 250 L400 300 L0 300 Z" fill="#8bc34a"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Frame -->
  <path d="M100 220 L160 180 L200 220 L240 190 L280 220 L320 190" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="8" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M160 180 L200 220" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="8" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Wheels -->
  <!-- Rear Wheel -->
  <circle cx="100" cy="220" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="220" r="35" fill="#f5f5f5" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="220" x2="100" y2="180" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="220" x2="60" y2="220" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="220" x2="140" y2="220" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Front Wheel -->
  <circle cx="300" cy="220" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="220" r="35" fill="#f5f5f5" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="220" x2="300" y2="180" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="220" x2="260" y2="220" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="220" x2="340" y2="220" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Pedals -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="220" r="5" fill="#5d4037"/>
  <rect x="195" y="215" width="10" height="8" fill="#5d4037"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Body -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="160" rx="60" ry="45" fill="#ffccbc" stroke="#e64a19" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Head -->
  <circle cx="230" cy="130" r="28" fill="#ffccbc" stroke="#e64a19" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Beak -->
  <path d="M258 130 L290 110 L310 130 Z" fill="#ffccbc" stroke="#e64a19" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="275" cy="120" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#ffab91" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Eye -->
  <circle cx="235" cy="125" r="3" fill="#333"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Wing -->
  <path d="M180 145 Q160 170 140 150 L150 145 Z" fill="#ffccbc" stroke="#e64a19" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Legs -->
  <path d="M180 195 Q175 210 180 230" stroke="#ffab91" stroke-width="6" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M220 195 Q225 210 220 230" stroke="#ffab91" stroke-width="6" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="180" cy="235" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ffab91"/>
  <ellipse cx="220" cy="235" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ffab91"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Handlebars -->
  <path d="M240 190 L260 170" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="260" cy="170" r="8" fill="#5d4037"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Seat -->
  <path d="M190 180 L210 180 L215 165 L185 165 Z" fill="#5d4037" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
